topPRs.title: feat(proxyd): add configurable per-method RPC cache TTLs
topPRs.author: jelias2
topPRs.body:
**Description**

Proxyd currently caches a fixed list of immutable RPC methods. Add opt-in, Redis-only per-method TTLs so repeated read requests near the chain tip can reuse responses briefly:

```toml
[cache]
enabled = true

[cache.method_ttls]
eth_getBlockByNumber = "1s"
eth_getBalance = "1s"
eth_call = "1s"
```

Each method plus its complete original parameters has a separate cache entry; request IDs do not participate. All argument combinations qualify, including numeric blocks and `pending`. Errors, null results, and locally synthesized responses are skipped. Preserve original parameters across backend rewriting so lookup and insertion use the same key.

**Tests**

Cache unit and HTTP integration tests pass, covering:
- Config decoding, positive whole-second TTL validation, and rejection of known write/state-consuming methods.
- Argument separation, caller IDs, all block selectors, expiry, skipped results, and block rewriting.
- Legacy Redis key compatibility and unchanged default method eligibility.
- Timed methods bypassing the cache without Redis, including overrides of built-in cached methods.
- Redis outages: timed methods continue forwarding to backends without memory fallback, while legacy immutable methods retain their existing fallback.
- Existing cache/read-replica integration behavior.

**Additional context**

Existing configs need no changes. Legacy Redis keys, immutable method defaults, global TTL default (1h), memory LRU behavior, and immutable-cache memory fallback are preserved. Redis writes and command metrics still use `SETEX`.

New method TTLs require Redis and never use memory fallback. Without Redis configured, timed methods bypass caching. Redis read/write failures use the existing fail-open cache path; existing Redis startup checks still apply. Explicit method TTLs override built-in policy for that method. Unlisted methods remain unchanged.

Per-method TTLs must be positive whole seconds (`"1s"`, `"5s"`, `"1m"`); fractional seconds are rejected. Keys include the TTL to isolate rolling policy changes. HTTP only; concurrent misses are not coalesced. Timed entries accept added staleness and are not reorg-aware. Configure only read-only custom methods; known transaction-submission, filter creation/polling, and subscription methods are rejected.

topPRs.title: ci: use validated Melange runner profiles
topPRs.author: falcorocks
topPRs.body:
Melange builds now use Factory’s validated compute profiles while retaining the same runners and architectures. The catalog and planner/workflow pins migrate together; publishing, smoke testing, and runner access policies retain their current configuration.

Validation: old/new planner comparisons preserve resolved runner choices and existing matrix values across manual, pull-request, and non-release-tag scenarios; Actionlint passes.
